name: Apothecary
line: A quiet apothecary on warm stone: a tall 4:5 still life slowly cross-fades from a leaf shadow on a Lisbon wall to feathery wild barley beside a light Cormorant headline, and the two explorers are set like formulations, each a large umber network drawing beside a hairline composition table of its figures.
notes: The cross-fade is pure CSS (24 s cycle, 2.4 s dissolves) and rests on the leaf shadow with reduced motion. The network drawings are recoloured umber with an inline SVG colour-matrix filter; the smoker and non-smoker bars share one 0–120 per 1,000 scale. Cormorant Garamond has Cyrillic but Instrument Sans does not, so the RU site would need a Cyrillic text face; Chinese falls back to the system font.
